Bayesian workflow (Gelman, Vehtari & McElreath 2026, Fig. 2.1) in nof1-causal-lab terms

Six actions replace the book's “Choose your focus”. The four that commit turn the book's loop back to the start into one return lane each, in that action's shade; data_diff and model_diff only read, so they have none.
A card's strip repeats the book's step; its body names the ModelSpec field, action, derivation or finding that carries it here. Checked against master on 2026-09-29.
read-only: a report, no commit, no lane
Return lanes: one per action that commits,
in its shade and named at the bottom left;
a step joins (dot) the lane it calls next
its branches are the book's outcomes
Book step: the strip repeats the
implements it here, or the gap.
Small scale simulation tests · SBC. prepare_data turns a simulate
replicate into a panel for fit, but nothing summarises recovery or
ranks truths. Diffrax replicates also test fit's Euler–Maruyama
steps, so an SBC failure would mix sampler and discretization error.
Influence of prior. No power-scaling or posterior contraction,
although every fit keeps its prior revision.
Fit and computation provisionally accepted. Convergence is now judged
and gates causal effects, but no acceptance is recorded, and causal
certification still ignores predictive checks and LOO.
Models are not compared by their inferences
Comparing inferences · multiverse · stacking. model_diff and data_diff
set two revisions side by side, but nothing computes effect or ELPD
differences, and no set of branches is run together.
Cross validation. PSIS-LOO interpolates with future rows and is off in
config.yaml; there is no leave-future-out or one-step-ahead PIT.
Chains cannot find a second mode
Check for multimodality · stack chains. All chains start near one
Pathfinder mode and are pooled with equal weights.
The book's extended workflow and our README aim at decisions, but
there is no utility, loss, decision rule or experiment design.
